summary: MetalFX offers GPU temporal and spatial upscalers plus frame interpolation, all fed by Metal textures and command buffers. BifrOSt has no upscaling scaler: its nearest code is CPU bilinear resampling and a GL_LINEAR blur pyramid on the GLES presenter, neither of which takes motion, depth or colour-space input.

features.note: Needs per-frame colour, depth and motion vectors. The presenter (springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs:147) receives CPU rasters uploaded on damage (docs/gpu-first.md, layer model) and no motion or depth buffers.
No denoiser and no temporal history buffer in the GPU path.
Only CPU bilinear resampling exists (asset density, box draws, control-centre preview). No edge-aware spatial scaler and no GPU path; these are resamplers, not upscalers.
The bilinear helpers take no colour-space argument, so input and output space are implicit.
No frame generation anywhere in the shell or the GPU presenter.

features.feature: Metal command-buffer encoding of scaler passes
features.apple: encode(commandBuffer:) on each effect; MTL4FX* protocols
features.bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs:147 (Presenter), docs/gpu-first.md (one render pass per present, GLES)
features.note: The presenter runs GLES render passes, not Metal. Apps get no SDK API for GPU passes. Metal itself is Apple-only, so the API shape is n/a; the concept of GPU passes is os-level.

features.feature: Reduced-resolution GPU work with linear upscale
features.apple: Render at low resolution, upscale to output (MetalFX landing page)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs:724 (blur pyramid upscale, GL_LINEAR), docs/gpu-first.md:85 (quarter-size base), springboard/render/src/gfx.rs:423 (blur_material)
features.note: The only GPU upscale: the blur pyramid and material blur run at 1/2 or 1/4 size and scale back up with a linear filter. Internal to the shell; no app-facing scaler.

gaps: Motion vectors and depth input for temporal scaling: the presenter has no per-pixel motion or depth buffers.
Spatial upscaler on the GPU: only CPU bilinear resampling exists, in springboard/render/src/gfx.rs and springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs.
Frame interpolation (macOS 26 API) and the temporal denoiser: no counterpart.
App-facing scaler API in bifrost_app: none, so apps cannot request GPU upscaling of their own render targets.
Colour-space-aware scaling (linear, perceptual, HDR modes): the bilinear helpers take no colour-space parameter.
